parsedVerdict.reasoning: The application module covers one concern: use cases for order fulfilment. Four order use cases (Advance, Cancel, List, Place) all go through the shared OrderDto/toOrderDto abstraction in order-dto.ts and order-mapper.ts. None maps orders inline. Status validation calls the domain's isOrderStatus rather than copying the status list. Order state changes go through Order.advanceTo/cancel, and stock invariants live in StockAllocationService (reserve/release). So no business rule is duplicated inside the module. GetStockLevelsUseCase reports the stock that the order use cases reserve and release, so it fits the same concern. Minor issues that don't reach the fail threshold: (1) the "find order or throw NOT_FOUND" guard appears in both advance-order-use-case.ts and cancel-order-use-case.ts, but it's a small guard, not a domain invariant; (2) StockLevelDto is declared in order-dto.ts, which isn't the most fitting file name; (3) GetStockLevelsUseCase maps products to DTOs inline, but no stock mapper exists, so nothing is bypassed.
